heading: Thursday, February 13, 2025
topLine: AI-designed enzymes with multistep serine-hydrolase active sites.

items.headline: AI-designed enzymes with multistep serine-hydrolase active sites
items.summary: The Baker lab combined RFdiffusion with PLACER, a network that scores whether an active site stays preorganised at each step of a reaction, to design serine hydrolases from scratch, long difficult because catalysis passes through several intermediates. Published in Science: over 300 designs were tested in the lab, the best reached catalytic efficiencies around 2.2x10^5 M^-1 s^-1 with crystal structures matching the models, still short of natural enzymes.
